## 📝 Summary

Provide clear context about the problem this change addresses.

> Describe the **underlying problem, gap, or motivation** behind this change.

> Avoid just stating what was changed — help others understand **why** this change matters.

> Keep it concise, but informative enough that someone unfamiliar with the ticket/story can understand the purpose.

## 💡 Solution

Explain the solution in clear, easy-to-understand terms.

> Focus on **what changed** functionally and **why** — not which files were modified.

> Think of this as explaining the change to a teammate who hasn’t been following the story.

> Highlight key decisions, workflows affected, and any important trade-offs or assumptions.

## 🧪 QA +1 Instructions

If possible, provide clear instructions for how a teammate can verify it.

> Include relevant steps, context, or commands — especially if setup is non-trivial.

> **Make this easy enough for someone unfamiliar with the story to follow confidently.**
